description:
This is a screenshot of the CLC+ (Copernicus Land Cover+) Core web interface, showing a "Data Catalogue" page for defining "Output Classes" for land cover extraction. The URL is `https://clcplus-core.land.copernicus.eu/datacatalogue/extraction/9c6ee53d-0fd3-4c53-bf50-ac8f935e8...`.

The page features a left panel for "Additional Documents," allowing users to "Drag and Drop" or "UPLOAD DOCUMENT/S" with a note that "All documents that help to understand the content. (No file type restrictions)."

The main content area on the right displays two sections. The upper section, partially visible, appears to be a list of existing land cover components or rulesets, including:
*   Rank 3, Code 2: "Coniferous" linked to "HRL - Dominant..." and "Trees" with a value of "+1".
*   Rank 4, Code 2: "Woody - needle..." linked to "CLC+Backbone (...)" and "Trees" with a value of "+1".
*   Rank 5, Code 4: "Woody - broadl..." linked to "CLC+Backbone (...)" and "Trees" with a value of "+3".
*   Rank 6, Code 29: "324 - Transition..." linked to "Corine Land Cov..." and "Natural Material Su..." with a value of "+9".
*   Rank 7, Code "CONTINUOUS": "Tree Cover Dens..." linked to "HRL - Tree Cover..." and "Trees" with a value of "+1".
Each item has an associated checkbox, a colour square (dark green, light green, lime green, yellow-green, dark green respectively), and a toggle switch, all appearing active.

The lower section is titled "Output Classes" and presents a table-like structure for defining new output classes. The visible headers are "Rank *", "Class Code *", "Name *", "Ruleset *", "Colour", and "Show in Map".
One row is displayed, likely being edited:
*   Rank: 1.
*   Class Code: 1
*   Name: FL Transitional woodland
*   Ruleset: `cov("LCC-woody-vegetation", 5) >= 30`. This rule specifies that the coverage of Land Cover Component (LCC) "woody-vegetation" with barcode 5 must be greater than or equal to 30%.
*   Colour: A white square.
*   Show in Map: A green toggle switch is active, along with an eye icon (view) and a trash can icon (delete).
Both the upper and lower sections have a plus `(+)` icon, indicating the ability to add new entries.

The footer of the screenshot includes logos for "Copernicus Europe's eye on Earth", "BIONET Action Group EAGLE Land Monitoring in Europe", "European Commission", and "European Environment Agency". The system tray shows the date "18.12.2023" and time "10:28".
